definition: The engineering discipline of designing deterministic control structures, safety guardrails, and validation cycles around non-deterministic LLM iterations.
details: Loop engineering addresses failure modes in multi-step agent executions (such as infinite execution cycles, task drift, and semantic divergence) by implementing strict termination guarantees, state schema validation, and memory pruners.

citation.title: Language Agent Tree Search Unifies Reasoning, Acting, and Planning in Language Models
